dct_description_sm: Monitoring of pollen and fungal spore content in the air since ~ 1976-. The Kevo Subarctic Research Institute is internationally well known. Of the specific areas of strength of the University of Turku, Kevo represents the main site for long-term ecological and environmental field-experiments. Specific attention has been paid into the design of experiments, and consequently, we have powerfull experiments to investigate the subarctic forest ecosystem. Manipulative experiments addressing cause-effect relationships of anthropogenic environmental changes and long-term environmental monitoring at Kevo support each other in a unique way. Environmental research benefits also from the long tradition of basic research in ecology and geosciences, and the high quality experimental research in these fields.
